title: A junk IEX bid read as a breached stop and the position was flattened
cause: At 13:51:20 the IEX quote was bid 161.16 against ask 166.38 (3.2% wide) while the real price was about 166.4. That bid sat below the 165.98 synthetic stop, so the bot flattened a healthy position. Both flattens were then cancelled when /positions showed a partial fill that the order record had not merged yet, and re-sent. Fix on review branch: a quote wider than max_quote_spread_pct cannot judge a stop (the broker validates instead), and a quantity disagreement is re-read from the broker before anything is cancelled.
evidence: orb_iex-20261026.jsonl 13:51:16-13:51:32; same race also seen in RPRX, XLP, FENY and VGT as 'broker quantity mismatch' cancels, and in CLF as an 'unsafe exit inventory' cancel; every one returned HTTP 422 already filled
